title: Measures, Perimeter & Area

scenes.t: We measure length in mm, cm, m and km. A pencil is measured in cm, a swimming pool in m, and the distance from Cairo to Port Said in km (about 220 km).
Remember: 1 metre = 100 centimetres, 1 kilometre = 1000 metres. So 2 m = 200 cm, ½ km = 500 m, and 3 km = 3000 m.
Mass: 1 kilogram = 1000 grams. Capacity: 1 litre = 1000 millilitres.
Perimeter is the distance all the way around a shape. Add all the sides. A square with sides of 4 cm has perimeter 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 16 cm.
A rectangle 5 cm by 4 cm has perimeter 5 + 4 + 5 + 4 = 18 cm.
Area is the space inside a shape. On a grid, count the squares! A rectangle 5 squares by 3 squares has area 15 square units.

items.a: The space inside; count the squares.
